hardware: Apple M4 Max, 48 GiB unified memory
protocol: Cold process per model, budget and profile. Run sequentially with no competing benchmark or build. After server readiness, warm up with 15/8 and then 4000/8. Time three separate uncached requests of 4000 input and 64 output tokens. Use each model’s historical token-ID fixture, temperature 0, seed 42, ignore EOS. TTFT is request-to-first-token SSE time. TPS is 63 divided by seconds between first and last token-bearing SSE events. Request time is request-to-last-token. Medians are independent. Managed and process lifetime physical high-water marks include startup and warmup. ATOMIC_WINDOW_PROFILE=1 only records prefill path. No live resize.
correctness: Compare all 64 output IDs with the historical same-model, same-mode, same-cap reference at 8 GiB and above. Also compare the three outputs to each other. SHA-256 uses little-endian uint32 token IDs. This sweep did not capture vocabulary logits.
